subject: SeedForge cohort — credits split, onboarding governance, and billing flow
messages:
From: Leah Cho <leah@seedforge.org>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@seedforge.org>
Date: Fri, 29 Oct 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: New cohort — ask on credit split, onboarding governance, billing flow

Hi Marcus & Vanessa,

Thanks again for partnering with SeedForge for cohort 14. A quick ask from our side ahead of the intake call next week: a few founders have requested the ability to split the onboarding credits between their sandbox (for early experimentation) and a reserved environment we intend to purchase later in the cohort. Specifically: 

- Can Redwood issue a single promo allocation that can be apportioned 60/40 between a SeedForge-managed sandbox and the team’s later Dedicated pool?
- Is there an audit/governance record showing who used credits (SeedForge vs founder account) for program reporting?
- If we provide a single PO from SeedForge for the Reserved environment at week 4, can credits be reallocated to the dedicated instance without double-counting?

We also need to surface typical procurement timing for smaller non-profits in the cohort — some need invoice + 30 net rather than credit card flows. Attached is a draft SOW and our PO template for reference. 

Appreciate any constraints or standard guardrails you can share before the intake call.

Best,
Leah
Program Director, SeedForge

Attachment: SeedForge_SOW_v1.pdf (pdf, 92KB)
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Leah Cho <leah@seedforge.org>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 29 Oct 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New cohort — ask on credit split, onboarding governance, billing flow

Hi Leah — thanks for the clear summary and the SOW. Quick responses inline, then a proposed path forward.

- Single promo allocation & split: Yes, we can create a single promo bucket scoped to the SeedForge program and allow mapping rules so credits can be used against either a SeedForge-managed sandbox project or a founder’s Reserved instance. We treat the bucket as program-level credits; usage attribution is by project id.

- Audit/governance: We provide per-project and per-token attribution logs for any program bucket. Your program admins can pull a CSV with daily usage broken out by project and email. That satisfies most reporting needs; if you need SSO-level linkage we can map projects to your SSO groups.

- Reallocation when a PO comes in: We can implement a reallocation flow so credits are deducted only once. The usual process is: SeedForge consumes from the program bucket for sandbox usage. When a founder upgrades and you submit a PO referencing the deal id, we move the remaining credited balance into the Dedicated instance and mark the move in the audit trail so there is no double-counting. We’ll need the PO to list the project IDs or the founder account emails.

Procurement note: We support invoice NET30 for approved non-profit partners. That requires a short underwriting step (KYC) and an approved billing contact.

Proposed next steps:
1) I’ll draft a short onboarding checklist and a simple reallocation playbook showing exactly when to open a ticket and what fields we need on the PO.
2) Vanessa — can you confirm finance acceptance for NET30 for SeedForge cohort partners and any minimum PO thresholds?
3) Leah — if you can send a sample of the founder project IDs (or a spreadsheet mapping email -> project id) we’ll validate the reallocation in our sandbox.

I attached a one-page flow diagram and the PO mapping template. Happy to walk through on the intake call.

Thanks,
Marcus
Head of Startup Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachment: PO_template_seedforge.xlsx (spreadsheet, 12KB)
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Leah Cho <leah@seedforge.org>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 29 Oct 2027 11:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New cohort — ask on credit split, onboarding governance, billing flow

Thanks Marcus and Leah — quick finance confirmation: NET30 invoicing ok for SeedForge program for cohort partners classified as non-profit or early-stage incubators, no minimum PO dollar threshold for the credit reallocation itself. Two operational items: 

- We need a signed MSA or an Addendum referencing the promo allocation for SeedForge (legal standard).
- For NET30, billing contact + billing address + tax ID (if applicable) required before we switch accounts to invoice terms.

I’ll loop in billing ops separately with a short checklist; for now we’re good on pricing and credit treatment.

Vanessa
Senior Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Leah Cho <leah@seedforge.org>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 29 Oct 2027 12:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New cohort — ask on credit split, onboarding governance, billing flow

Awesome — thank you both. Two quick clarifications from our side: 

1) Can the audit CSV include “program_credits_used” vs “paid_usage” as separate columns? Our reporting requires that split per founder.
2) A few founders want to reserve a dedicate instance but not incur charges until week 4; will Redwood hold the reserved instance claim while billing stays to the SeedForge bucket until reallocation?

I'll prep the spreadsheet mapping founders -> project IDs and circulate before Monday. Also attaching the SOW back with minor edits where we call out reporting cadence.

Best,
Leah

Attachment: SeedForge_SOW_v1-edits.pdf (pdf, 18KB)
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Leah Cho <leah@seedforge.org>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 29 Oct 2027 16:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New cohort — ask on credit split, onboarding governance, billing flow

Hi Leah — answers: 

1) Yes, the audit export will include program_credits_used / paid_usage as separate columns by default. I’ll include an example CSV in the onboarding packet so your reporting folks can validate.

2) Yes — we can reserve an instance for the founder and mark billing to remain with the SeedForge bucket until you issue the reallocation request (we’ll need the trigger via support ticket with PO reference). We’ll hold the capacity claim for up to 21 days without charging the Dedicated billing entity. If the founder doesn’t confirm within 21 days, the reserved instance will release.

I’ll send the onboarding checklist and the reallocation playbook by end of day Monday; Vanessa will follow up with the legal/billing checklist. Looking forward to the intake call.

Thanks,
Marcus
